latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Caption Generator Free — auto-generate captions for videos in English and Spanish.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for instant AI-captioned video output.
- Supports automatic cloud-based caption generation in 30–60 seconds, with export to 1080p MP4 by default.
- No technical expertise required — simply describe your needs, and captions are applied automatically.
- Handles session management and free anonymous tokens, with a 100-credit, 7-day free tier.
- Get timeline previews, credits balance, status updates, and easy video export — all from the chat interface.
